title: When an abstract class is still preferable after Java 8
answer: Default and static interface methods did not replace abstract classes. Prefer an abstract class when related subclasses need shared instance state, constructors, protected helper methods, enforced initialization, or a controlled inheritance template. Prefer an interface when the main goal is a capability contract that many otherwise unrelated classes should implement, especially when multiple contracts are useful.
